newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Air NZ to make afternoon announcement on Ansett.
newsitem.headline: Air NZ to make afternoon announcement on Ansett.

text.p: Air New Zealand will make a further announcement on its plans to buy 50 percent of Ansett Airlines Ltd, a spokesman said on Wednesday.
The conference is expected to confirm Air NZ's intention to buy the stake and may include details of how it expects to fund the purchase, expected to be around A$325 million.
TNT Ltd, which has agreed to sell its stake to Air NZ, said on Tuesday it was also considering holding a news conference on Wednesday.
Industry sources said Australia's Foreign Investment Review Board is expected to give the green light to Air NZ's buy-in although that is unlikely to be announced until next week.

The proposal has been approved by the New Zealand Commerce Commission after it initially declined the plan because of fears about the operation of Air New Zealand's domestic competitor, Ansett New Zealand, owned by Ansett Australia.
The new proposal has Ansett's other half owner, Rupert Murdoch's News Corp Ltd, managing Ansett New Zealand at arm's length.
